title: acs-implement run state
description: Working Memory scheduler details referenced by the configured recovery entry. Canonical tickets own durable status; entries here are derived execution observations. Retain necessary evidence before cleanup.

brief.description: Readable accepted ticket brief and binding constraints; never an implementer report.

diff.description: Readable complete BASE-to-current diff, or scoped FIX_BASE diff for re-review.

base.description: Immutable dispatch source identity backed by a retrievable snapshot.

input_revision.description: Consumed ticket/design input identity, independently checked for freshness.

recovery_entry.description: Coordinator-resolved sole recovery entry; default <work-root>/<run-id>/state.md. Explicitly configured JSON entry may identify this file.

acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical criterion IDs from the spec

ticket_path.description: Coordinator-resolved canonical ticket path or tracker reference

evidence_path.description: Coordinator-resolved evidence reference. Retain criterion-linked evidence before dependent handoff or cleanup.

fix_rounds_used.description: Persist before each correction dispatch; independent of B8 retries_used. Never reset on resume or executor replacement.

review_result_path.description: Ordered spec/quality verdicts, cannot-verify items and dispositions, reviewed source/input identities. Coordinator checks current evidence before done.

fix_base.description: Previous reviewed source identity; original dispatch BASE remains immutable.

failure.description: Present when status is failed: what failed and where the evidence is

frontier.description: Ticket IDs ready to dispatch now: all dependencies done, parallel-safety checked

parallel_safety.description: Per-ticket concurrency verdicts with the rule that decided them
